title: Blue-Green Deployment
summary: Reduce downtime by running two identical environments and switching traffic after testing.

content.overview: Blue-green deployment reduces downtime by maintaining two identical environments and routing traffic after validation.
content.details: Process: 1. Blue environment serves production traffic; 2. Deploy new version to green environment; 3. Test green environment; 4. Switch traffic from blue to green; 5. Keep blue as rollback option.
